summary_en: On November 10, 2026, NAGASE & CO. will execute a share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 1,113 yen (November 9), acquiring up to 2,695,400 shares (0.7% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 3.0 billion yen.
title_en: Notice on Share Buyback via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, NAGASE & CO.'s Board of Directors authorized a share buyback program with an upper limit of 3.5 million shares (0.86% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) and 3.0 billion yen, to be executed through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 between November 9 and November 30, 2026. The company subsequently determined the specific execution method for this authorization.

On November 10, 2026, at 8:45 a.m., the company will execute a ToSTNeT-3 transaction at the closing price of 1,113 yen recorded on November 9. The buyback will target up to 2,695,400 shares with an upper limit of 3.0 billion yen. The order will be valid only during the designated trading session, and execution results will be published after the session closes. As of November 9, no shares had yet been acquired under this authorization.
